businesses.business: specialty pharmaceuticals for rare neurological disorders

offering_description.value: Develops and commercializes pharmaceutical therapies for rare neurological disorders, notably narcolepsy. Sells prescription drugs to patients in the US through a specialty pharmacy network. Drugs are made by contract manufacturers.

primary_products.value: pitolisant tablets for narcolepsy sleepiness and cataplexy; pipeline neurology drug candidates

customer_segment.value: B2C: patients with narcolepsy prescribed therapies by neurologists and sleep specialists; B2B: specialty pharmacies purchasing the drugs

end_markets.value: pharmaceuticals; neurology; sleep medicine; rare diseases

revenue_model.value: product sales: prescription drug sales via specialty pharmacies, largely reimbursed by insurers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: develops and markets drugs made by contract manufacturers, sold via specialty pharmacies to patients

geography_served.value: global: Mainly US sales, partners and early access programs in Europe and other markets

specialization.value: niche specialist: rare neurological disorder drugs, centered on narcolepsy treatment and related pipeline

distribution_channels.value: other: central specialty pharmacy network dispensing to patients by prescription; partners / resellers: licensing and distribution partners outside the US

regulatory_exposure.value: high: prescription drugs need FDA approval, also EMA and other health regulators, plus controlled-substance and marketing rules
